# ui-nav

> Sidebar navigation with roving focus and selection indicator.

**Class:** `UINav`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `value` | `string` | Currently selected nav item value |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables all nav items |

## Events

| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `ui-change` | Fired when selection changes with `{ value, label }` detail |

## CSS Tokens

Public `--ui-*` custom properties consumed by this component:

- `--ui-focus-ring`
- `--ui-font-weight-button`
- `--ui-font-weight-text`
- `--ui-line-height-control`

## ui-nav-item

> Selectable navigation item within a nav component.

**Class:** `UINavItem`

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `value` | `string` | Item value emitted on selection |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables this item |
| `label` | `string` | Display label (falls back to text content) |

### Events

| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `ui-select` | Fired on click with `{ value, label }` detail |
